raw_record.support_text: In case 1, the patient had been on pravastatin and developed an acute symptomatic hepatitis; tests for viral hepatitis were negative (anti-HAV IgM, anti-HBc and anti-HBc IgM, HBsAg, anti-HCV) and eosinophil count, ANA, IgG and IgA were normal. Liver enzymes returned to normal 10 weeks after discontinuing pravastatin.
raw_record.extra_details: Episode of acute symptomatic hepatitis with ALT, AST, ALP and total bilirubin elevations; liver enzymes returned to normal 10 weeks after discontinuing pravastatin; elevated IgM (6.15 g/L, reference 0.44-3.40 g/L), antismooth muscle antibody titre 1:40; normal ultrasound of liver, gallbladder and biliary tree; viral hepatitis serologies negative.
